206:t_1:3.en: ～ $$メリダ島$$ $$ミスリル$$ $$西太平洋戦隊$$ HQ, Office ～

206:t_1:4.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「...$c shook off $$サイデリアル$$'s pursuit and succeeded in escaping the Eurasian continent.」

206:t_1:6.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「What are your orders, Captain?」

206:t_1:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Ordinarily, we should leave here as well and go to support them, but...」

206:t_1:8.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「You mean 《$$アマルガム$$》, then...」

206:t_1:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$'s investigation has revealed that their collaborators are lurking even within $$ミスリル$$'s own organization...」

206:t_1:10.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even so, I still have not been able to grasp the full extent of their organization.」

206:t_1:11.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Even when we get hold of what looks like a promising source, the route is cut off at once, and we can't trace it any further...」

206:t_1:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I surmise that their organization is not a pyramid-style, top-down structure, but one where decisions are made by the consensus of several powerful executives.」

206:t_1:13.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「And those executives are found all over the world. Even if one goes missing or another joins, the network carries on unbroken...」

206:t_1:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It is like a spider's web. Because of that structure, there is no head of the organization either, so we can't deal a decisive blow...」

206:t_1:15.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Even now, as the Empire tries to rule the world, $$アマルガム$$ continues its activities.」

206:t_1:16.en:
$$テッサ$$
「They cooperated with $$ジェミニス$$ in the $$時獄戦役$$ too. They are probably still in league with the Empire.」

206:t_1:17.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Do they intend to sell the Earth off to that bunch...?」

206:t_1:18.en:
$$テッサ$$
「An emergency line...!? What on earth...!」

206:t_1:22.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's right. I am $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$.」

206:t_1:23.en:
$$レナード$$
「And I am also an executive of $$アマルガム$$, the enemy of you people at $$ミスリル$$.」

206:t_1:25.en:
$$レナード$$
「Are you shocked that I knew the emergency communication code of the $$西太平洋戦隊$$?」

206:t_1:26.en:
$$テッサ$$
「No... I was only a little surprised that you showed your face to me in person.」

206:t_1:27.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even if it's over a monitor, it's a reunion of a real brother and sister after six years, and twins at that. Shouldn't you be a little happier about it?」

206:t_1:29.en:
$$レナード$$
「Shall we talk a little about Father and Mother?」

206:t_1:30.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That's surprising. I didn't think you still remembered Father and Mother.」

206:t_1:31.en:
$$レナード$$
「I remember them. That's the problem.」

206:t_1:32.en:
$$レナード$$
「You've grown, $$テレサ$$. You've become much stronger and more beautiful than before.」

206:t_1:33.en:
$$レナード$$
「Has riding around in that prized submarine of yours that sails through space been good experience for you?」

206:t_1:35.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...I lost many subordinates in the fighting against you people.」

206:t_1:37.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If I learned nothing from that, I would be insulting their lives.」

206:t_1:38.en:
$$レナード$$
「The dead have no honor or dignity.」

206:t_1:39.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Did you go to the trouble of contacting us just to talk about this?」

206:t_1:40.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Let me be clear. You are my enemy, Brother.」

206:t_1:41.en:
$$レナード$$
「...I wanted to settle this with talking alone...」

206:t_1:43.en:
$$レナード$$
「I see. You seem to have made up your mind.」

206:t_1:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
「This is my final warning. Stop lending them a hand.」

206:t_1:45.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$テレサ$$... You're the one who should finally give up on them.」

206:t_1:47.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll take that as your final decision.」

206:t_1:48.en:
$$レナード$$
「Goodbye, $$テレサ$$... You and everything you hold dear will be finished soon.」

206:t_1:51.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$マデューカス$$, immediately issue an emergency alert across all of $$メリダ島$$ and put every crew member on combat stations.」

206:t_1:53.en:
$$テッサ$$
(The all-out attack by $$アマルガム$$ is finally beginning...)

206:t_1:54.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$相良$$, $$カナメ$$... I pray that you both stay safe.)

206:t_1:59.en:
$$田中司令$$
「All right, everyone... thank you for your hard work. Now that we've taken refuge at the Far East Branch, even the Empire's pursuit forces won't be able to lay a hand on us so easily.」

206:t_1:60.en:
$$赤木$$
「You've worked hard too, $$田中司令$$. Securing the retreat route from $$ラース・バビロン$$ to Japan must have been tough.」

206:t_1:61.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Somewhat... But the annihilation of $c was something we had to avoid at all costs.」

206:t_1:62.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Has $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ been on the Eurasian continent this whole time?」

206:t_1:63.en:
$$葵$$
「Pretty much. We wanted to join up with $c, but $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$ wouldn't give the OK.」

206:t_1:64.en:
$$くらら$$
「Just in case, we were taking out the enemy strongholds between $$ラース・バビロン$$ and Japan... That was our mission.」

206:t_1:65.en:
$$マオ$$
「Thanks to that, we were saved. We're grateful.」

206:t_1:66.en:
$$葵$$
「Even if you say that, it's not a situation where we can just be happy about it.」

206:t_1:67.en:
$$朔哉$$
「It was partway through that fighting that we met everyone at $$２１世紀警備保障$$.」

206:t_1:68.en:
$$大杉$$
「It was a help to us as well.」

206:t_1:69.en:
$$横沢$$
「On the President's orders, we were rescuing refugees on the Eurasian continent too, but the situation was close to a deadlock.」

206:t_1:70.en:
$$大山$$
「Thanks to $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$'s cooperation, we managed to get those people out too...」

206:t_1:71.en:
$$谷川$$
「And they picked us up as well, so it's a real case of killing two birds with one stone, isn't it.」

206:t_1:72.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「We are honored to have been of service.」

206:t_1:73.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So you joined up with Colonel $$シャア$$ around the time the route was secured.」

206:t_1:74.en:
$$マオ$$
「If the Colonel hadn't moved his own forces, we could never have made it to Japan.」

206:t_1:75.en:
$$田中司令$$
「They joined the local resistance as they were, and Colonel $$シャア$$ and $$マリーダ$$ will act together with $c for the time being.」

206:t_1:76.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「The problem is what comes next, isn't it...」

206:t_1:77.en:
$$中原$$
「The captains and the others have been in talks with Director $$大塚$$ this whole time, but...」

206:t_1:78.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Understandable. Now that the desperate gamble to take $$ラース・バビロン$$ has failed, the war with the Empire is expected to turn into a quagmire.」

206:t_1:79.en:
$$くらら$$
「Thanks to the final defense line in the southeast Eurasian continent and the hard work of $$新日本$$, Japan has been reasonably peaceful, but...」

206:t_1:81.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Even Japan, the last peaceful place on $$蒼の地球$$, is going to get dragged into the fires of war...」

206:t_1:82.en:
$$入江$$
「If that happens, our company will...」

206:t_1:83.en:
$$石塚$$
「Don't say such ominous things, $$入江$$.」

206:t_1:84.en:
$$田口$$
「That's right...! If you think about the company going under...」

206:t_1:85.en:
$$伊集院$$
「No hope! The future is pitch black...」
